aug-lr has no test result I can report. Its run crashed partway through epoch 7 of 10 with a CUDA out-of-memory error, so it never produced test predictions (`runs/aug-lr/train.log:11`). The summary below says so rather than leaving a gap.

---

**Results summary (topic classifier, 5 classes, test set n=1000)**

| run | config | test acc | test macro-F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | lr 3e-5, bs 32, no aug | 0.806 | 0.805 |
| aug | lr 3e-5, bs 32, aug p=0.3 | **0.829** | **0.828** |
| aug-lr | lr 1e-4, bs 64, aug p=0.3 | n/a | n/a |

- **Augmentation helps:** aug beats baseline by about 2.3 points on both accuracy and macro-F1. The validation results agree (0.847 vs 0.821 accuracy).
- **aug-lr didn't finish:** it ran out of GPU memory during epoch 7 of 10, so there's no test result. Its validation accuracy after epoch 6 was 0.839, below aug's best of 0.847 but still going up, so it isn't ruled out yet.
- **Recommendation:** go with **aug** for now. If we want to settle the learning-rate question, I'll rerun aug-lr with a smaller batch size (or gradient accumulation) so it fits in memory.

Note: these numbers replace the Sep 12 figures in the README (0.884 / 0.913 accuracy), which came from earlier runs.

---

I wrote the last bullet assuming you'd rerun aug-lr. Drop it if you're not planning to.
